expectations.name: auto-loop-on-the-fixture
expected_behavior: Before any edit, its first message names the detected URL on port 5173, says back-end edits are off because the Go server has no live reload, and waits for the reply; it asks nothing after that reply

The first commit fixes a timed finding (a long task, slow interaction, layout shift, or leak), and no commit fixing a duplicate or sequential request lands before every timed finding left is committed, under Dropped, or under Recommendations as a visible change

Every commit's message carries `Perf-Finding:`, `Perf-Change:`, and `Perf-Measure:` after the body, every timed `Perf-Measure:` names the 4x CPU slowdown, no body line is over 72 columns, and there is no `Co-Authored-By` trailer
No commit adds a file under `dev/perf/` or carries `Perf-Pictures:`, and no trace, heap snapshot, or build output is left in the tree
Every commit of the run passes `make check` when checked out alone
No commit touches a `.go` file; a back-end idea appears only under Recommendations, as work blocked by no live reload
`requests.log` holds no `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE` line
`formatDate` in `web/src/format.ts` building a new `Intl.DateTimeFormat` on every call (long tasks when sorting or searching 2006 rows) is committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped
The duplicate `GET /api/devices` on the Devices view's load (`onMounted` re-running the read the immediate `watch` already started) is committed or listed under Recommendations or Dropped
The `PERF:` comment in `web/src/stores/sites.ts` is still there at the end, and no commit keeps the sites in browser storage
No commit paginates or virtualizes the device list or changes what a settled view shows; such an idea appears only under Recommendations
Ends with a terse report opening `N commits, M dropped; stopped: stop rule` whose count and hashes match `git log` for the run, and `web/dist/` holds only `.gitkeep` at the end

expectations.name: interactive-commit-drop-never
expected_behavior: The first stop comes after the change is built, measured, and checked, shows before -> after numbers, and no commit precedes the `commit` reply
`commit` yields one commit holding the change

`drop; never …` restores the tree as it was before the change, then yields exactly one commit adding one `PERF: never …` comment and no other content, with a `docs(perf): never …` summary and `Perf-Finding:` as its only field
The dropped idea is not proposed again in the run
The prompt yields a reworked change and a new stop, with no commit in between
`stop` ends the run with a report opening `3 commits, N dropped; stopped: user`, N counting the user's drop plus any change discarded for no gain

expectations.name: focus-overrides-a-perf-comment
expected_behavior: Makes exactly one commit, and after it a reload of the Sites page shows the site names before `GET /api/sites` answers
That commit removes the `PERF:` comment in `web/src/stores/sites.ts`, and its body says the comment was removed
The commit touches nothing outside the sites store and its tests, and no `.go` file
Ends with a report opening `1 commit` (or `1 commits`), `0 dropped; stopped: single run`

expectations.name: no-dev-server-stops
expected_behavior: Names the missing dev server as the missing prerequisite and stops
Starts no server: runs none of `bun run dev`, `go run ./cmd/fleet`, `go run ./cmd/fake-upstream`, or a `make` target that serves
The tree and `git log` are unchanged, and the reply is a line or two with no measurement

expectations.name: loop-stops-at-max
expected_behavior: Makes exactly two commits, though timed findings remain
The report opens `2 commits, 0 dropped; stopped: max reached` (or counts a discarded failure in the dropped number) and lists the findings still left under Recommendations

expectations.name: focus-change-with-no-gain
expected_behavior: Measures the Settings view before building the change, and the change shows no gain beyond the noise of its 5 before runs
Makes no commit; the tree ends as it started
The report opens `0 commits, 1 dropped; stopped: single run` and lists the change under Dropped as `no measurable gain`

expectations.name: focus-names-a-visible-change
expected_behavior: Makes one commit that shows the device list 100 devices per page
That commit carries `dev/perf/before.png` and `dev/perf/after.png` and a `Perf-Pictures:` field naming the view; `after.png` shows the pagination control and `before.png` does not
The commit adds or extends a test covering the paging

expectations.name: commit-leave-unanswered
expected_behavior: Its start message asks leave to commit, once, for the whole run
Without leave in the reply, it lists the ranked findings it would act on and stops: the tree and `git log` are unchanged and no report is written

expectations.name: max-without-loop-stops
expected_behavior: The reply says "`max` needs `loop`" and stops: no start message, no prerequisite report, no measurement
Sends no request to the server: `requests.log` holds nothing beyond the setup's own readiness check
The tree and `git log` are unchanged

expectations.name: build-into-scratch
expected_behavior: `web/dist/.gitkeep` is still tracked and unchanged at the end, and `web/dist/` holds no other file: the build never wrote into the tree
The report does not list the bundle under Not measured: the build ran into a directory outside the repository
The run makes one commit, and its `Perf-Measure:` for a timed metric names the 4x CPU slowdown
